svg.title: Yomika mark
svg.desc: Yomika mark without its rounded square: the foreground layer of the Android adaptive icon, and its monochrome layer. The black behind it comes from the manifest's bg_color. The mark is drawn at 42% of the canvas (not the 53% the print icon uses): Android only shows the middle 72dp of the 108dp adaptive canvas, so the same 53% would read as ~80% of the visible squircle and the frame would nearly touch its edges. 42% of the canvas = ~63% of what is actually visible, which leaves the ~17% margin launcher icons are drawn with. This padding is what `android_fg_scale` was supposed to do — it is inert in tauri-cli 2.11.4, measured: 50 changes nothing.
